calibration_rulings.title: "The Kingdom" where the page never names the country (salwa-beach: "the Kingdom's land gateway to Qatar").
calibration_rulings.binds: salwa-beach::body (change 13 of round 1). Every later page whose sources say "the Kingdom".
calibration_rulings.ruling: B. Where a source says "the Kingdom" and the page has not named the country, the Urdu writes the termbase key «سعودی عرب» at that first mention: «جہاں خشکی کے راستے سعودی عرب کا دروازہ قطر کی طرف کھلتا ہے». It names what both sources mean and adds no fact; the Chinese and Russian lines did the same. After the country has been named on a page, «مملکت» may take it up. A is not an error — the Gulf's Urdu paper writes the bare noun for readers who live there — and is the owner's option, one line, if he wants the source's noun kept. The gateway image is the source's and is kept; the first reader's plain "border crossing" is not written. (Ruling N62, which does not name the country beside the province, is untouched: there the source names no country at all.) ROUND 2: CONFIRMED on the second reader. ROUND 3: CONFIRMED for the country's name, on two readers. THE CLAUSE AROUND IT has now cost all three readers a second look (moderate, minor, moderate) and all three arrived at the crossing: the gateway is the source's image, the door that 'opens by a land route' the Urdu's build of it. It is not a misreading and no wording of it has passed a reader, so it stays in the last round, charged on the page. ON RECORD FOR THE OWNER, one line: a plain sentence in place of the image, as the first and third readers wrote it («جہاں سعودی عرب اور قطر کی زمینی سرحد ہے»; «جہاں سے سعودی عرب اور قطر کے درمیان زمینی راستہ گزرتا ہے») — each states a border or a route where the sources say a gateway.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the bare word for the Kingdom does not stand on a page before the country's name.

calibration_rulings.title: "Al-Ahsa governorate" («محافظة الأحساء») in a sentence about administrative dependence (salwa-beach).
calibration_rulings.binds: salwa-beach::body (round 1's change 14, round 2's change 4). Every later sentence that says a place falls under Al-Ahsa administratively.
calibration_rulings.ruling: D, with the subject first since round 2. The Arabic generic is not carried into Urdu where the sentence states the fact without it: «سلویٰ انتظامی طور پر الاحساء کے تحت آتا ہے۔» Round 1's change 14 took the generic out; round 2's change 4 sets the subject first, so that the two bare names no longer touch (proof pass on round 1, finding 1: with the adverb first, the subject and the name after it read on first pass as one name). The adverb and «کے تحت آتا ہے» say that the dependence is administrative. THE RULE THAT DECIDES is the style rule `arabisms` of the termbase — an Arabic word of the source is not carried over where the Urdu reader does not use it: as the name of an administrative unit the word has no dictionary headword (the dictionary's word of that spelling is another word), its reference attestation is thin and partly machine-written, and the first reader read it as another word. Round 1 also called on ruling P16-test; that test is worded for English loans and is not needed here (proof pass, finding 20). Stage 4 asked for two readers; one who misreads the word as another word is enough on a sentence whose fact survives without it. THE SECOND READER did not miss the unit: to him the sentence is office language that repeats what the first sentence implied (minor) — the source's sentence. B is refused (the bracket states an equivalence with a district that neither source gives; the pack rules no gloss); C is a loan with a Pakistani meaning of its own; the first reader's «ضلعے» is B without its bracket. The key «محافظہ الاحساء» is retired from this batch's proposals. WHERE THE FORM IS RECORDED FOR SEARCH: in the note of the entry «سلویٰ کا ساحل سمندر» in `termbase_final` of this file; the coordinator copies that line into the note of the repository's entry «الاحساء» when the batch is applied. COST, counted under accuracy: the source's generic is not rendered, and with it the KIND of unit — that the Al-Ahsa meant here is the governorate and not the oasis; after a first sentence that sets Salwa at Al-Ahsa's far end, the adverb alone carries the difference (proof pass, finding 14). The three earlier lines kept the unit on this field. FOR THE OWNER, one line: the unit restored if he wants it named, «سلویٰ انتظامی طور پر محافظہ الاحساء کے تحت آتا ہے۔». A later page that must NAME the governorate as such (a heading, a list of governorates) raises the word again as its own item with this record. ROUND 3: CONFIRMED. With the subject first nobody read the two names as one; two readers call the sentence office language, which is the source's sentence.
calibration_rulings.guard: Stage checker (read from this entry by R/tools/lib/rulings.mjs): «محافظہ» does not occur as a whole word. For the proofreader, not machine-read: the sentence keeps the adverb that says the dependence is administrative.

calibration_rulings.title: "Bodies of water" in the owner's guarded claim on asfar (build check C31: «من أكبر التجمعات المائية»), and "a body of water" of hubail-lake («مسطح مائي»).
calibration_rulings.binds: asfar::summary (change 0 of round 1); hubail-lake::body (change 19 of round 1). The Urdu pattern of build check C31, which the coordinator derives from asfar's summary as it stands after the last round.
calibration_rulings.ruling: B for the claim, E for the lake. Both stand in round 2, each contested by one reader, and this is why. (1) asfar's summary: «خلیجی خطے کے سب سے بڑے آبی اجسام میں سے ایک». The three points build check C31 holds every language to are kept and are what the Urdu pattern is to be derived from: AMONG the largest («میں سے ایک»), BODIES OF WATER («آبی اجسام» — not «جھیل», not «قدرتی»), of the REGION («خلیجی خطے», the Gulf bare: ruling P5). THE TWO READERS SIDE BY SIDE: the first read the earlier wording and pictured a man-made tank behind a dam — a wrong picture of the place, on the owner's guarded claim; the second read «آبی اجسام», understood it as water bodies, and found it a word-for-word, textbook phrase. One wording misleads and the other stumbles; on a guarded claim the one that does not mislead stays. The second reader's own wording, «خلیجی خطے میں پانی کے سب سے بڑے ذخیروں میں سے ایک», is candidate C, the noun that misled the first reader, and is not taken. No third wording is coined: none was found that keeps the three points. ON RECORD FOR THE OWNER, one line each: candidate C as the second reader words it; and 'lakes', the first reader's remedy, which the owner's own guard forbids. (2) hubail-lake's body follows the Arabic's other noun: «پانی کا ایک پھیلاؤ», the phrase asfar's body has for the same Arabic word. The second reader finds that the sentence defines a lake as water and sounds translated, and would drop the predicate; both sources open with it ('Al-Hubail Lake is a body of water …'), and a predicate of the field's source is not dropped for register (ruling P24): his sentence is on record for the owner, «جھیل الحبیل الاحساء کے شمال میں ہے۔». The singular «آبی جسم» is attested and is not taken there. (3) The earlier noun and its plural are withdrawn for a natural or drainage-fed lake: the word is a store of water and is read as a dam's reservoir. For a reservoir it is the right word. HOW THIS AND THE GUARD AGREE (proof pass on round 1, finding 20): the guard forbids the two forms wherever this entry is in force (the attraction batches of the line's round 3), and no page of this batch speaks of a reservoir; the page that does raises the word as its own item, and its judge lifts the ban in his own file — this entry carried there with its guard reworded, and the key back in his `termbase_final` — until then the form is not written. COST, stated: «آبی اجسام» is schoolbook Urdu and cost the second reader a stumble on the first line of the page; charged under nativeness and fit on asfar. ROUND 3: BOTH STAND, each now contested by the two readers who have read it, neither misread. (1) The claim: two readers independently wrote the same sentence with «پانی کے … ذخیروں». Its noun, in the build of stages 1 to 5, gave the first reader a dam's tank; their own build has been read by nobody; the claim is the owner's guarded one. The last round changes a wording only to cure a misreading and only for a wording a reader has passed: neither holds. THE OWNER'S DECISION, no longer a mere option: «آبی اجسام», which is understood and sounds like a textbook, or the two readers' sentence. (2) The opening of hubail-lake: two readers wrote the same sentence without the predicate. It is the source's predicate and ruling P24 keeps it; THE OWNER'S DECISION likewise. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-13) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN (the judge file gives this entry the status "ruled"; by the proof pass on round 3, finding 1, accepted in the judge's addendum, it is entered with its open question stated, as N88 and N100 state theirs). The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 3): N93: (a) asfar's guarded claim — «آبی اجسام» (understood; textbook to two) or the sentence two readers wrote, «خلیجی خطے میں پانی کے سب سے بڑے ذخیروں میں سے ایک»; (b) hubail-lake's opening without 'a body of water', «جھیل الحبیل الاحساء کے شمال میں ہے۔», which two readers wrote. ‖ AMENDED IN b16 (judge round 1, 2026-10-15; items N241, N251): hubail-lake's body now says «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں» (owner, inside). Question (b), should the owner take it, reads «جھیل الحبیل الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں ہے۔»; the on-05 reader of b16 wrote that sentence with the withdrawn noun of (3) added after the position (item 28, ruled open_item; not a third candidate). The ruling, the guard and the open question are otherwise unchanged.

calibration_rulings.title: "(fountain shows after sunset)" («عروض النافورة من بعد المغرب»): the noun for a staged show, and its number.
calibration_rulings.binds: king-abdullah-park::practical[0].value (round 2's change 7), and this one cell only. A later 'show' of lights, water or fireworks is NOT bound by this entry: its page raises the noun as its own item, with this record.
calibration_rulings.ruling: D SINCE ROUND 2: «(فوارے کی نمائش غروب آفتاب کے بعد)» (round 2's change 7). A is WITHDRAWN: BOTH readers read its noun as a protest before they read a show (first reader, item 43; second reader, item 42), and round 1 had named the second reader as the test. WHY D: of the wordings on record it is the one that says no more than the sources. «نمائش» (feminine, plural «نمائشیں») is a showing or display — the Arabic's own noun, «عروض»; the dictionary gives it as exhibition, show, spectacle, display; the reference site has it for a staged display beside the withdrawn noun («آتش بازی کی نمائش» 3 pages against «آتش بازی کا مظاہرہ» 10) and for the showing of a film (61 pages). ITS KNOWN COST: it is also the word for an exhibition (so on the applied baiah: things put on display), and nothing attests it of a fountain — 0 pages, as for every other wording. B, the plural of stage 1, is the withdrawn noun in the form the headlines use for protests. F, the press's «فواروں کا رقص», says a dance and several fountains where the Arabic has shows of ONE fountain. C, the verb, says that the fountain runs: less than a show. E, the loan, does not enter: P16-test, condition 1, is still not shown — no page was obtained that writes the loan of a fountain. NUMBER: singular, a display that takes place daily, where both sources have the plural 'shows'; the Urdu plural of this noun reads as exhibitions. The change of number is counted under accuracy. No hour is supplied and nothing is tied to a prayer. READ IN ROUND 3 by the third reader (his item 47, moderate): it 'reads first as an exhibition of a fountain; I then understood a fountain show'. The known cost showed, as a first-pass stumble that corrected itself inside the bracket; he was not left with an exhibition. THE CELL STANDS. C, the verb, was weighed as the recorded fallback and is not taken: it says that the fountain runs, less than a show, and no reader has read it — the last round does not replace a wording that was understood by one that is unread. THIS RULING BINDS THE ONE CELL AND NO OTHER (proof pass on round 2, finding 2): what a later page calls a show of lights, water or fireworks is raised by that page as its own item and ruled on its own reader, with this record before it. An approved text is not changed by this entry: a later change of the cell is the owner's or a later round's. FOR THE OWNER, as a decision: the loan. All three readers write it («فوارہ شو», «فوارے کا شو», «فواروں کا شو»), after two native nouns that each cost a reader his first pass; his rule on loans (P16) keeps it out, and no page was obtained that writes it of a fountain (P16-test, condition 1). F stays his other option. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-13) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN (the judge file gives this entry the status "ruled"; by the proof pass on round 3, finding 1, accepted in the judge's addendum, it is entered with its open question stated, as N88 and N100 state theirs). The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 4): N94, the park: 'fountain shows' with the loan all three readers write, or «فواروں کا رقص», or as it stands («فوارے کی نمائش», understood on a second pass).
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the bracket carries no clock time and the noun is in the singular.

calibration_rulings.title: delfoon-lake: one lake in the title and the questions, several in the text, in both languages.
calibration_rulings.binds: delfoon-lake: title, summary, body, faq[0].q, faq[0].a, faq[1].q, faq[2].q — unchanged in number from stage 5. ROUND 2: delfoon-lake::body and faq[0].a, the noun for 'cluster' (round 2's changes 8 and 9).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. calibration_rulings.ruling: THE WORDING, kept for the text until the owner answers: A, «الاحساء کی قومی تفریح گاہ», by ruling N69 and item N101; a batch judge reopens neither, and the owner's rule on loans (P16) is his. THE NAME OF THE THING is the OWNER'S DECISION: does a national park take the loan on /ur/? If yes: B, «الاحساء نیشنل پارک» (the reference's order; no possessive in the compound, as ruling N85 builds a compound title), in the title and where the body's first sentence names the park by its title, with the agreeing verb there following the gender the dictionary gives the loan; a termbase entry citing P16 and this evidence; and a proof pass and a blind read of the page. The body's other mentions of a park («ایک عوامی تفریح گاہ», «اس تفریح گاہ») keep ruling N69's noun. C is on record. THE JUDGE'S RECOMMENDATION: B for the national park alone — all three conditions of the test are met, and two readers of two missed what the place is from its title. Whether a park as such takes the loan is a wider question that ruling N69 answers today, and this item does not touch it. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN. The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 3): N119 (NEW): does a national park take the loan, «الاحساء نیشنل پارک»? Two readers of two did not recognise the place from its title; the judge recommends yes, for the national park alone. ‖ OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-14: the native title stands: «الاحساء کی قومی تفریح گاہ»; no loan «نیشنل پارک». The "if yes" of this entry does not apply. ‖ OWNER REVERSED 2026-10-15: the loan «پارک» for 'park' everywhere in /ur/, replacing «تفریح گاہ»; the answer of 2026-10-14 above ('the native title stands') is withdrawn, and with it the park generic of N69, N101 and N121 where it is «تفریح گاہ» (a garden stays «باغ»; the resort of N69 is not a park and is for the judge who meets it). «پارک» is masculine (its own entry): every agreeing verb and adjective follows. Done in the interface in b13-ui (nav.leisure, list2.title, crumb.leisure, det.allLeisure, CATEGORY_LABELS.parks). national-park's title and body, and every park page's titles, bodies and cards, are worded through the line in b14/b15 (N195). What the owner admitted is the noun «پارک»; the adjective stays «قومی» unless the b14/b15 judge admits «نیشنل» under P16-test. ‖ ROUND 2 (proof on r1, item 9): the rulings that still name «تفریح گاہ» as the park generic in their text or guard (N65, N69, N85, N101, N102, N103, N112, N117, N121, N122, N124, P3a) are withdrawn on that point by this entry and are amended by the b14/b15 judges where they reword the park pages; the guards of this file bind interface batches only.

calibration_rulings.title: Titles named after a person or a family (Al-Moosa, Al-Khalifa, Abdulrazaq Al-Arab): ruling N85's compound, or N101's possessive?
calibration_rulings.binds: musa-park::title, khalifa-museum::title and body, abdulrazaq-museum::title. Every later place named after a person (N85) and every later private museum named after its founder or his family (this item).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A FOR A PLACE NAMED IN HONOUR OF A PERSON OR FAMILY, B FOR A PRIVATE MUSEUM NAMED AFTER ITS FOUNDER OR HIS FAMILY. (1) musa-park keeps ruling N85's compound with no possessive, «الموسیٰ تفریح گاہ»: a public park whose possessive would say an ownership the sources do not state (the hospital co-founded the initiative); the reader passed it. (2) A private museum named after its founder or his family takes the Urdu possessive: «الخلیفہ کا ورثہ عجائب گھر», «عبد الرزاق العرب کا عجائب گھر». Ruling N85 is not reopened: its reason is that a possessive after a person's name 'says ownership', and for a private museum the ownership is what the sources say (the founder began it in his own garden and built the collection; the English body of abdulrazaq-museum says 'the museum of'). Ruling N101 (a place name + possessive) is untouched and gives «الاحساء کا عجائب گھر». THE TEST stage 4 named was the blind reader, and he failed the compound on both museums: «العرب» read as 'the Arabs' until the body's possessive (item 28, moderate), and «ورثہ» stuck between name and generic (item 32, his wording taken). Gender by the generic: musa-park's title feminine («تفریح گاہ»), the two museum titles masculine («عجائب گھر»). ROUND 2: CONFIRMED with its cost. The second reader read «الخلیفہ» as 'the Caliph's' and «العرب» as 'the Arabs' in the possessive titles, as the first had read «العرب» in the compound: the homograph belongs to the family name in any form and nothing inside the rulings fences it (no vowel sign, P8/P17; no word that says 'family', which no field states). The possessive is kept: it is the English body's own form for abdulrazaq-museum, and the first reader said it was what let him read a family name. Recorded for the owner. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN (the judge file gives this entry the status "ruled"; the list for the owner names no entry, and its decision 7 is the question this ruling concerns; it is entered with its open question stated, as b6 entered N93, N94 and N99 and b7 entered N106 and N110). The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 7): The family names «الخلیفہ» and «العرب» read as "the Caliph" and "the Arabs" by both readers in both title forms; nothing inside the rulings fences them. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14), proof pass on round 2, note 6, record only (no string moves): the candidate list of this entry in the judge file, which the termbase does not carry, labels candidate A (the compounds, as the proof pass names them) "(in the text)", but the two museum compounds it quotes, «الخلیفہ ورثہ عجائب گھر» and «عبد الرزاق العرب عجائب گھر», are withdrawn and no longer stand in the text (musa-park's compound stays, as item (1) of the ruling says); the label reads "(stage 4's text)", the smallest correction the proof pass words. The ruling above says what replaced it. ‖ AMENDED IN b14 (judge round 1, 2026-10-15; OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-15 (N119 reversed; DECISIONS «Owner's answers on 2026-10-15», «Batch b13-ui», «Batches b14 and b15»); item N202 A): (1) musa-park's title is «الموسیٰ پارک», masculine by «پارک»; the clause 'musa-park's title feminine («تفریح گاہ»)' is withdrawn. The compound stands, and item N199 B makes it the pattern of every park named by a proper name. (2) is unchanged.

calibration_rulings.title: list2.lead: «فارموں» bare in running text, or «زرعی فارموں» (N5's label form)?
calibration_rulings.binds: list2.lead; running text generally.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. N5's qualifier «زرعی» is owed where «فارم» stands UNQUALIFIED as a label or a list item, as in nav.leisure «بازار، پارک اور زرعی فارم», where two readers read the bare word as the form one fills in. It is not owed where a possessive or an attribute already qualifies the word, because that context fixes the sense. Here «فارموں» is qualified by «نخلستان کے» («نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں»), so the bare oblique stands. This is the ground of the approved texts too: «زکی السالم کا فارم», «اسٹرابیری کا فارم», and «… کاشت کرنے والے سب سے بڑے فارموں» on zaki-alsalem-farm. The kind of string (lead, meta description, heading) does not decide it. A string ruled a meta description under N184 is not, by that alone, owed the qualifier. This agrees with N5 and changes none of its forms. ‖ AMENDED IN b13-ui (judge round 1): the nav.leisure it quotes is the value since b13-ui (OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-15 (N119 reversed; DECISIONS «Owner's answers on 2026-10-15», «Batch b13-ui»)); the reasoning and forms of the ruling are unchanged.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader: «زرعی» before «فارم» where the word stands unqualified as a label or a list item (N5: nav.leisure «بازار، پارک اور زرعی فارم», the farm category label «زرعی فارم»). It is not required where a possessive or an attribute qualifies it («… کا فارم», «نخلستان کے … فارموں», «… والے … فارموں»). A bare «فارم» as a label or list item is a finding; a qualified one is not.
calibration_rulings.ruled_by: Judge round2, b12-ui (round 4), 2026-10-15; record corrected by the judge's addendum to that round; quotation amended by the b13-ui judge, round 1, 2026-10-15

calibration_rulings.title: det.unescoNo: the loan «نمبر» for 'no.' / «رقم».

calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «نمبر» is admitted on P16 itself (an English loan enters with a dictionary-cited entry, and only where no common Urdu word has the sense): «عدد» is a numeral, «شمارہ» a periodical's issue, and no common native word names an item's number; «نمبر» is a headword of Urdu Lughat with Urdu idioms (udb.gov.pk) and the ordinary word in reference usage (ur.wikipedia «ٹیلی فون نمبر», «گاڑی نمبر پلیٹ»). P16-test, made for a function the interfaces name with a loan, is not its ground: its condition (2) is not met and is not claimed. Two readers read it in place without a stumble on the word; that is recorded, and sets no precedent for admitting a loan a reader passes. Entry verified (termbase_final). Masculine; plural «نمبر», oblique «نمبروں». B misleads; C drops the source's 'no.'. (Round 1 said 'all three conditions met': corrected here.)
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: «نمبر» follows the noun it numbers («حصہ نمبر {n}»); «شمارہ» is not used for an item's number.

calibration_rulings.title: The pattern of a park title with the owner's noun «پارک»: N101's possessive (A) or the compound name + «پارک» (B), for b14 and b15 at once.
calibration_rulings.binds: Every park title named by a proper name in b14 and b15, every mention of such a name in bodies and questions, the official name in kanzan-park's body; the termbase keys of the six b14 titles, kanzan-park's official name, and b15's king-abdullah-park and stadium-park. Every later park page.
calibration_rulings.ruling: B — THE COMPOUND for every park whose title is named by a PROPER NAME (a place, a spring, a mountain, a person or family): the name as its termbase key, then «پارک», no possessive; masculine. b14: «الاحساء قومی پارک», «جواثا پارک», «عین النجم پارک», «المشقر پارک» (former name in its own clause: «جو پہلے الشیبانی پارک کہلاتا تھا»), «جبل کنزان پارک (الشعبہ)» with N103's bracket, the official name «“جبل الشعبہ پارک”» (N72), «الموسیٰ پارک» (N85, unchanged). b15: «شاہ عبد اللہ ماحولیاتی پارک» (N85, unchanged); a title whose head is a DESCRIPTION keeps the possessive: «کھیلوں کے اسٹیڈیم کا پارک» (N124). A garden stays «باغ» («الکوت کا باغ», N121). WHY: (1) Urdu names parks as compounds — person, neighbourhood, river, lake and Arabic article names alike (stage 4: «اقبال پارک» 117 / «اقبال کا پارک» 0; «جناح پارک» 128 / «جناح کا پارک» 0; «ماڈل ٹاؤن پارک», «چناب پارک», «الحسین عوامی پارک»), while «… کا پارک» is descriptive («جنگلی حیات کا پارک»); (2) N101 refused the compound because it was 'attested once with this generic' — a reason about «تفریح گاہ» that the owner's noun removes; N101 itself named A's cost, that the title 'reads as a description … rather than as what the place is called'; (3) one pattern on the leisure index instead of two, which the reader of this round noticed (item 35); (4) the jabal name takes a following generic as a compound («جبل علی بندرگاہ» 2 / «… کی بندرگاہ» 0), so D is refused; C is refused (stage 4). COST, named: the six names are unattested in Urdu in either form (stage 4: 0 each), so the choice is by the pattern, not by a count; for the national park alone A was attested too («دونانہ کا قومی پارک»), and the set is not split on it. The text changes in 13 leaves (changes 0–12), no agreement moves; the seven keys are entered in the compound (termbase_final) and the old keys retired. UNREAD: the proof pass and a fresh blind read on this round follow before apply. ‖ ROUND 2: CONFIRMED on the fresh reader and the proof. termbase_keys_retired lists the seven old keys of the termbase and the six possessive keys proposed at stages 1–4, which were never entered: the meta step retires only the first seven (proof on r1, note 7).
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: a park title named by a proper name is the name as its termbase key, then «پارک», with no «کا» / «کی» / «کے» between them; a title whose head is a description (b15 stadium-park) keeps the possessive; every body or question mention of the page's name is the title's key byte for byte, inflected only by a following postposition («جواثا پارک میں»); agreeing forms masculine. The stage checker holds titles to their keys and reports a retired key (termbase_keys_retired below).

calibration_rulings.title: Fruit card names (interface headings h4, also the first cell of the seasons table) with a source bracket: under P3c-labels and N103, which bracket may they keep, and does N103's clause 'the whole title a termbase key' apply?
calibration_rulings.binds: The card names fruits.g1.f0.name, fruits.g2.f4.name and fruits.g3.f1.name (a bracket each) and fruits.g1.f1.name (no bracket, N283 C); every later fruit or product CARD NAME whose source names close with a bracket. calibration_rulings.ruling: A. A fruit card name keeps the second name both source names close with, in one closing bracket, as that name's termbase key and nothing else; N103's purpose — the bracket holds a registered NAME, never a gloss — is met by the bracketed name being a key. The clause 'the whole title a termbase key' binds page titles and is not applied to card names, which are not keys (B would enter fifteen phrases of N281 as names). No gloss, no Urdu name of the fruit and no generic in a card-name bracket (P3c-labels); a source bracket that holds a gloss on either side gives no bracket (N283 C). calibration_rulings.title: An image of the source that the Urdu renders with a fixed phrase of another sense, or literally enough to mislead: mandi ’not so much cooked as entrusted to the earth, the way secrets are’ (AR «لا يُطهى … بل يُستودَع في باطن الأرض كما تُستودَع الأسرار»).

calibration_rulings.ruling: D (round 2): the image stays; no wording of it reads as burial or as undercooking. (1) Where an Urdu fixed phrase carries a sense the source’s image does not (burial: «زمین کے سپرد», «امانت» in the earth), the image is said in the source’s own terms — the Arabic’s, the authority: in the depth of the earth, kept as a secret is kept. (2) Where the literal form of a contrast measures what the source only ranks (’not so much cooked as’ → «پکایا کم جاتا ہے», read as ’little cooked’), the contrast ranks: «پکانے سے بڑھ کر». The verb is «سنبھال کر رکھنا» (to keep with care, the frame of a secret kept); the ’trust’ nuance of «يُستودَع» is what leaves, charged under accuracy. A and B are withdrawn; C refused (adding information; the method is logged as the source’s). D is unread until the r2 blind read. ‖ AMENDED b20-ui (owner decision 2026-10-15): D stands with the owner’s plain sentence after it: «… جیسے راز سنبھال کر رکھے جاتے ہیں۔ سادہ لفظوں میں، یہ پکوان زمین کے ایک گڑھے میں دبے ہوئے تندور میں پکتا ہے۔». The plain sentence does its job (the reader learned the method from it); the figure, kept by the owner, still misleads when read first — logged for the owner (source_defects 1), not reworded on a reader’s charge. The rest of D’s ruling (the image said in the source’s own terms; the contrast ranks) stands; C of b19 (a plain method) is now the source’s own sentence, not an addition.

calibration_rulings.title: The order and form of an event place row that names a neighbourhood and its town (Arabic «حي X، المدينة»).
calibration_rulings.binds: ev.palm-village.place («محلہ محیرس، المبرز»). Every later event place row (TEXT_UR[*].place in src/data/events.ts) whose source gives a district and then a town. The nine sibling rows stand unchanged.
calibration_rulings.ruling: An event place row keeps its source's order: the specific place first, then «،», then the town as a bare name («محلہ محیرس، المبرز»; cf. «محلہ الوفرہ، ہفوف کے جنوبی حصے میں», «تاریخی قصر ابراہیم، ہفوف»). The Arabic «حي» is «محلہ», written once and before the name (N73 point 1). «نامی» is added only for a homograph of a common Urdu word (N73 point 2). A position («کے … حصے میں», «کے شمال میں») is written only when the source gives one, and the line then ends in the postposition. With no position the town stands bare, without «میں». Nothing the source lacks is added: no larger place («الاحساء») and no word for 'city'. P20 and N30 (larger place first in area_ur) bind attraction pages only and do not move an event row. Cost, stated: Al-Mubarraz comes last here but leads «الاحساء، المبرز کے شمال میں» on the muhairis attraction page. These are two fields with two settled orders.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: an event place row that names a district begins «محلہ X» or with the venue, and its town follows «،». It does not end in «۔» (P26). It carries no word that its Arabic place field lacks.

calibration_rulings.title: Trail stop names (H3) whose source names close with a second name in a bracket (stage 4's N504).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A, as stage 4 proposed: N294's reasoning applies to a trail stop name, an interface heading and not a page title. The stop name keeps the second name both source names close with, in one closing bracket holding that name's termbase key and nothing else, with the key's own P3b quotation marks where its entry requires them («بیت البیعہ (بیت الملا)»; «مدرسہ امیریہ (“بیت الثقافہ”)»). No gloss or Urdu generic in the bracket (P3c-labels). The alternative (second names in the stop text only) is refused: it drops names both sources carry. ‖ ROUND 2 (proofread r1 M1): THIS RULING AMENDS, in their texts (base_amendments of judge round 2), (1) the guard of P3c-labels, which now names a third case, trail stop names, beside N103's and N294's, and admits the key's own P3b marks inside the bracket; (2) N294's binds clause 'Not other interface headings, labels or section titles: they stay under N103's one case', which now excepts trail stop names. No string changes. ‖ ROUND 3 (proofread r2 M1; item N540): N283 (b18-ui) is the standing reading of "both": a source bracket that holds a gloss on either side is not a second name and gives no bracket. The English '(House of Culture)' is the meaning of «بيت الثقافة» (the termbase entry «بیت الثقافہ»: en 'Bait Al-Thaqafa (House of Culture)', gloss «ثقافت کا گھر»; the published English ameeriah body glosses it the same way), so the amiriya stop name is «مدرسہ امیریہ», bare, the published landmark title; «“بیت الثقافہ” (ثقافت کا گھر)» stays in its stop text. The third case is exercised by «بیت البیعہ (بیت الملا)» alone, where the English 'Al-Mulla House' carries the proper name, as kanzan's '(Al-Shu'bah)' did under N103. The clause admitting the key's P3b marks inside the bracket is withdrawn with its only case. The base amendments are restated, complete, in judge round 3.

No clear reason to hold: the values «پیدل», «گاڑی سے», «فور وہیل ڈرائیو گاڑی سے» read as answers to a label «سفر کا ذریعہ:» on a card; stage 4's concern (the «… سے» values pair less well) is weaker than two stumbles on the label. The termbase addition is replaced; the old form is kept in its note.

calibration_rulings.title: Jawatha stop text: the hadith clause and «دونوں».

(b) Proofread r2 R1: «دونوں ہی نخلستان کے حصوں», so «دونوں» cannot attach to «نخلستان». N534, N16 (2), P9 rider unchanged.
calibration_rulings.binds: trails.qarah-and-jawatha.stops.jawatha-mosque.text

calibration_rulings.title: 'Unification of the Kingdom' («توحيد المملكة»).

Option recorded for a later pass: «… کیسے زندگی گزارتے ہیں۔ راستے میں دور تک پھیلے کھجور کے باغات اور الاحساء کے چاول کے کھیت آتے ہیں، اور وہ قدرتی چشمے بھی، جن پر …».

calibration_rulings.title: artesian springs label
calibration_rulings.binds: ur-home-1
calibration_rulings.ruling: water.springsL «ابلتے چشمے» → «خود بخود پھوٹتے چشمے نخلستان کو سیراب کرتے ہیں». Evidence: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-ubalnaa lists «boil, boil over» first, so «ابلتے چشمے» risks reading as boiling/hot springs (an added claim); rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-phuutnaa gives «gush (tears or water)» and «(پانی وغیرہ کا) جوش زن ہونا»; the published Urdu site writes a spring «جو زمین سے پھوٹتا ہے»; «خود بخود» is in published TM. Neither «ابلتے چشمے» nor «پھوٹتے چشمے» has an ur.wikipedia hit (exact-phrase search, 0 each), and no Urdu headword for artesian exists (no loan, P16). «خود بخود» is the P28 component of the definition (water rising to the surface under its own pressure without pumping: dictionary.com 'artesian well'; Arabic «بئر ارتوازية» same), no measure or judgement. Binds: any later /ur/ string rendering عين ارتوازية / artesian spring. Termbase entry added as pending (no attestation of the full phrase).

calibration_rulings.title: the time slider
calibration_rulings.binds: ur-home-1
calibration_rulings.ruling: qarah.drag «پٹی» kept as the Urdu for the Arabic «الشريط» (rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-pattii-1: f., «strip», «tape»), qualified «وقت کی پٹی» because the same entry’s first sense is «bandage». Verb «سرکائیں» confirmed (rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-sarkaanaa: «slide or push to one side, shift»); gate.lead «صفحہ نیچے سرکائیں» and memory.track «دائیں بائیں سرکائیں» keep the same verb. Loan «سلائیڈر» not used (P16; no termbase entry). Binds later /ur/ slider/scroll instructions.

calibration_rulings.title: times of day on the Al-Qarah slider
calibration_rulings.binds: ur-home-1
calibration_rulings.ruling: «فجر / چاشت / ڈھلتی سہ پہر / غروب آفتاب» confirmed against the Arabic, not the English. «چاشت»: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-chaasht, m., the mid-morning watch between sunrise and midday (~9 am) = الضحى exactly; «صبح» (old-home TM for English 'Morning') rejected because beside «فجر» it reads as the same early hour. «ڈھلتی سہ پہر»: published old-home ref.ui home.route.time.lateAfternoon, the waning afternoon with the sun still up = الأصيل; «شام» rejected (evening; ref.ui has it separately for 'evening'). «غروب آفتاب» published. Series parallel, no stop. Binds later /ur/ strings naming الضحى / الأصيل.

calibration_rulings.title: Artesian springs label (amends N600); amended in round 2.
calibration_rulings.ruling: water.springsL «زمین سے پھوٹتے چشمے نخلستان کو سیراب کرتے ہیں». «خود بخود» dropped after the blind reader read it as an odd, sudden event (ur-home-1 r0 #3). Cost, recorded: «پھوٹتے» carries the gush of water rising out of the ground; the full artesian sense (rising under its own pressure, which N600 placed in «خود بخود») is not spelled out. The published site wording «جو زمین سے پھوٹتا ہے» (zaki-alsalem-farm) is used there for an ordinary natural spring, so it is evidence of idiom, not of the artesian component. «ابلتے» stays excluded (boil sense, N600). «قدرتی چشمے» is not written: it says less than «پھوٹتے» and nothing of «ارتوازية». ROUND 2 (proofread r1 R1, R2): rationale restated as a cost; water.lead takes «نخلستان کی پرورش کرتا ہے» for «يغذّي» (round 1 «پانی دیتا ہے» repeated «پانی» in one clause), so «سیراب» («تروي») stays water.springsL’s alone.
calibration_rulings.binds: Any /ur/ string rendering عين ارتوازية / artesian spring (the cost travels with the form); water.lead / water.springsL on the home page.

calibration_rulings.title: Al-Qarah slider: chapter title and instruction (amends N601); amended in round 2.
calibration_rulings.ruling: qarah.title «جبل القارہ: دن کا وقت اپنے ہاتھ سے بدلیں» (the image of «حرّك اليوم بيدك» kept: the hand, and the time of day it moves, named in the slider label’s own words qarah.timeLabel «دن کا وقت»). qarah.drag «تصویر پر لگی پٹی کو فجر سے غروب آفتاب تک سرکائیں۔»: the strip located where it sits, which keeps «پٹی» from its bandage sense. ROUND 2: «دی گئی» → «لگی» (proofread r1 R4, textbook ring). The calque «دن کو … آگے بڑھائیں» is not written. Loan «سلائیڈر» not written (P16; second reader’s request r1 #10 refused on the same ground). qarah.title kept after a second reader (r1 #8, medium): see N621.
calibration_rulings.binds: Later /ur/ slider instructions locate the strip where it sits (the principle); the words «تصویر پر» only where the control sits on an image (proofread r1 R5). Any string that renders «حرّك … بيدك».

calibration_rulings.title: The planner result: «سفری منصوبہ», not «راستہ» (ground restated in round 2; N336 wording corrected in round 3).
calibration_rulings.ruling: On the home planner the itinerary built from the three answers is «سفری منصوبہ» (m.): plan.routeTitle «آپ کا سفری منصوبہ», plan.lead, plan.wait. It is built on the page pair nav.planVisit / plan.title «سفر کا منصوبہ بنائیں». «راستہ» is kept for trails only on this page (plan.kindTrail «سیر کا راستہ» = nav.trails singular; ref.trails titles «… کا راستہ»). Ground: the blind reader took «آپ کا راستہ» as road directions and met «راستہ» at two levels in one panel (ur-home-1 #26). The same reading (route word taken as a road) led the owner in N336 (2026-10-17) to replace «راستہ» for the visa routes; N336 kept the itinerary «راستہ» on visa-guide («سفر کا بنا بنایا راستہ»), and N612 does not reopen that page. N336 is an analogy here, not a precedent: it decided regulatory routes (the visa routes and later regulatory options), not itineraries. The old-home pairs «تجویز کردہ راستہ» / «اپنا راستہ خود ترتیب دیں» retire with the old home (N336’s mention of the home pair amended in base_amendments); other pages’ «اپنا راستہ ترتیب دیں» (events.ctaD) are not reopened here. ROUND 3 (proofread r2 R1): the analogy sentence corrected, since N336 binds every later regulatory route or option, not the visa routes only. The two old-home tm.json pairs are listed in tm_retire for the coordinator (N633); N336 carries a dated record line appended after «‖», its owner text untouched (base_amendments; proofread r2 M2).
calibration_rulings.binds: plan.* on /ur/ home; any later /ur/ string naming the generated itinerary.

calibration_rulings.title: map.title «اختر ما يناديك».
calibration_rulings.ruling: «جو دل کو بھائے، وہ چنیں». The literal «جو آپ کو پکارے» read as a calque; the evaluative image is taken in the Urdu idiom (P19), no claim involved. Round 2: the fresh reader cites it as native travel writing.
calibration_rulings.binds: map.title; later /ur/ strings with «ما يناديك» / what calls you.

calibration_rulings.title: map.lead: no quantifier the source does not carry.
calibration_rulings.ruling: «نقشے پر سیاحتی مقامات اپنی اصل جگہوں پر دکھائے گئے ہیں۔» (proofread r1 M1). «ہر سیاحتی مقام» read as a completeness claim (every tourist site is on the map) where the map shows six and the Arabic says «المعالم في مواضعها الحقيقية»: an absolute of the kind P19 makes a claim that the Arabic must carry. The plural keeps the passive of round 1 (places shown, not moving) and drops the quantifier; «مقامات» (m. pl.) takes «دکھائے گئے ہیں». The touch verb «چھو کر» stands (owner question map-touch-verb).
calibration_rulings.binds: map.lead; any /ur/ string that renders a plural of landmarks: no «ہر» / «تمام» unless the source carries it.

calibration_rulings.title: qarah.title kept after a second reader.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A second reader (r1 #8, medium) paused on «دن کا وقت اپنے ہاتھ سے بدلیں» until qarah.drag explained it; he understood it then, as the first reader did with the round-0 form. Kept: the riddle is the source’s own (en “move the day yourself”, ar «حرّك اليوم بيدك» likewise only resolve with the slider), the image is the approved one, and the instruction is qarah.drag’s, one line below. Candidates weighed and not written: the reader’s «دن کے مختلف پہروں میں دیکھیں» / «صبح سے شام تک دیکھیں» (drop the hand; «شام» is not the last tick, N602); «پٹی سرکا کر دن کا وقت خود بدلیں» (turns the title into qarah.drag’s instruction and says it twice); «اپنے ہاتھ سے دن کا منظر بدلیں» (adds «منظر», still a riddle). Charged in nativeness (−2), as in round 1. If a third reader stumbles, the candidate for a round of its own: «جبل القارہ: پٹی سرکائیں اور دن کا وقت اپنے ہاتھ سے بدلیں».
calibration_rulings.binds: qarah.title.

calibration_rulings.title: gate.skip names what is planned; «سیدھے» before the verb (amended in round 3).
calibration_rulings.ruling: «سفر کی منصوبہ بندی پر سیدھے جائیں». Two readers (r0 #37, r1 #3) found «منصوبہ بندی پر جائیں» open (planning what?). «سفر کی» is what the chapter plans (rail.ch-plan «سفر کا منصوبہ بنائیں», plan.link «سفر کی منصوبہ بندی کی مکمل رہنمائی»); no fact, no page promised. «سیدھے» kept adverbial (spoken Urdu, r1 #37). «سیدھے» stands before the verb: before «سفر» it reads as the adjective of «سیدھا سفر» (round-2 form «سیدھے سفر کی منصوبہ بندی پر جائیں», proofread r2 M1, blind reader r2 #2). The reader’s «سیدھے سفر کا منصوبہ بنائیں» not written: it is the rail and finale button, which leads elsewhere. Round 3: «براہِ راست سفر کی …» not written (the same adjective reading: «براہ راست سفر» is a direct trip); «سیدھا منصوبہ بندی پر جائیں» not written (drops the object N622 added).
calibration_rulings.binds: gate.skip.

calibration_rulings.title: «القرى» in a title: «دیہات».
calibration_rulings.ruling: tpl.heritage-2.title «دو دن: پرانا شہر، پھر مشرقی دیہات». «گاؤں» is unmarked for number in the direct case and was read as one village (r1 #27); the Arabic is plural «القرى الشرقية». «مشرقی دیہات» is the published Urdu for these villages («الاحساء کے مشرقی دیہات», tm.json). Which villages they are is the template’s (owner-delegated ruling), not added.
calibration_rulings.binds: tpl.heritage-2.title; later /ur/ strings where a plural «قرى» stands without a numeral or plural agreement to mark it.

calibration_rulings.title: tip.friends: «وجهة تخييم ورحلات» (amended in round 3).
calibration_rulings.ruling: «… جبل الاربع ہے، جو خیمہ زنی اور گھومنے پھرنے کی جگہ ہے۔» Round 1 «سیر و تفریح» repeated «سیر» from the opening and tip.family’s phrase for «التنزّه», merging two Arabic words (proofread r1 R3; r1 #31). Round 2 «تفریحی سفر کیے جا سکتے ہیں» was read as translated (“doing recreational journeys”, blind reader r2 #32, medium). Round 3: the source’s «وجهة» is rendered as what the place is, «جو … کی جگہ ہے», the published build for “a destination for … outings” (jawatha-park summary «جو خاندان کے ساتھ گھومنے پھرنے کی جگہ ہے», tm.json). DELIBERATE SPLIT (proofread r2 R3): the two «رحلات» of the sentence are rendered apart, «الرحلات البرية» → «صحرا کی سیر» (published arbaa wording) and the second «رحلات» → «گھومنے پھرنے», so «سیر» stands once and does not echo tip.family’s «سیر و تفریح»; a later page must not merge them back. «خیمہ زنی» kept: it is the published arbaa summary and body wording; «کیمپنگ» not written (P16). Cost recorded: «گھومنے پھرنے» renders the English “outing” on jawatha-park; here it renders “excursion”, a near-synonym on a page that never shows the two side by side.
calibration_rulings.binds: tip.friends; any later /ur/ string that renders two «رحلات» in one sentence (the split).

calibration_rulings.title: P3c on the home page: no gloss owed for «سوق» / «عین».
calibration_rulings.ruling: Settled by proofread r1 (open question of judge r1, note [s7] 39): not required. No string of this batch contains either name; they stand only in published titles and summaries (ref.json, binding byte for byte). P3c-labels keeps titles and labels bare; P3c (1) owes the bracket only on the name’s own page, never in a summary; the «نامی» form of P3c (2) is for an attraction body, which the home page does not have. The Urdu generics «بازار» and «چشمے» stand near the names without touching them. Candidate (b) of round 1 («سوق القیصریہ نامی بازار» / «عین النجم نامی چشمہ») is not written; a change to the published summaries belongs to the site-wide amendment round (owner question published-ur-labels-flagged). Second reader’s remarks (r1 #14, #21) ruled out of scope on this ground.
calibration_rulings.binds: /ur/ home and any page that shows «سوق …» / «عین …» names only as published titles, labels or summaries.

calibration_rulings.title: Adverbial «سیدھے» stands before the verb.
calibration_rulings.ruling: In a button or instruction, adverbial «سیدھے» (“straight to”) is placed immediately before the verb, never before a masculine noun in the oblique: there it agrees as an adjective («سیدھے سفر کی …» = of a direct trip). Applied in gate.skip «سفر کی منصوبہ بندی پر سیدھے جائیں» (proofread r2 M1; blind reader r2 #2, an independent reader). The same holds for «براہِ راست», which is refused before a noun for the same reason.
calibration_rulings.binds: gate.skip; any later /ur/ string with adverbial «سیدھے» / «براہِ راست».

calibration_rulings.title: qarah.title after a third reader, in the final round.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A third reader (r2 #9, minor) found «جبل القارہ: دن کا وقت اپنے ہاتھ سے بدلیں» strange out of context, understood it from the next sentence and accepted it “as a playful heading”. N621 named a candidate «جبل القارہ: پٹی سرکائیں اور دن کا وقت اپنے ہاتھ سے بدلیں» for “a round of its own” if a third reader stumbled. Round 3 is the last round of this batch and no reader of that candidate is possible: a title written now would ship unread. Kept; three readers of three paused and all three resolved it from qarah.drag. Raised to the owner (owner_questions[qarah-title]) with the candidate as a one-line option. Nativeness stays charged −2 (N621).
calibration_rulings.binds: qarah.title.

calibration_rulings.title: Planner companion chips stay bare.
calibration_rulings.ruling: plan.com.family / friends / solo «خاندان» / «دوست» / «اکیلے» kept (blind reader r2 #24, minor). The chips answer the question shown above them («آپ کس کے ساتھ سفر کر رہے ہیں؟»), which supplies «کے ساتھ» and reads «دوست» as plural; the ctx asks for very short parallel buttons. «دوستوں کے ساتھ» alone would break the series, and the three-chip change «خاندان کے ساتھ / دوستوں کے ساتھ / اکیلے» is not made in a final round with no reader. Unlike tpl.heritage-2.title (N623), the number of «دوست» is not a fact the page states. Fallback recorded: the three-chip form above, all three together.
calibration_rulings.binds: plan.com.*.

calibration_rulings.title: Old-home tm.json pairs retired (tm_retire).
calibration_rulings.ruling: The tm.json pairs “Suggested route” → «تجویز کردہ راستہ» (ui, home.route.eyebrow) and “Arrange your own route in “My saved places”” → «“میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات” میں اپنا راستہ خود ترتیب دیں» (ui, home.route.link), both 2026-10-12, belong to the old home page that ur-home-1 replaces. Listed in tm_retire for the coordinator to mark retired, citing N612 (proofread r2 R2), so that a later TM match does not bring «راستہ» back for the planner result. tm.json is not edited by the judge. Neither pair matches any English string of this pack; events.ctaD «اپنا راستہ ترتیب دیں» and visa-guide «سفر کا بنا بنایا راستہ» are not retired.
calibration_rulings.binds: memory/tm.json (coordinator); any later /ur/ string that would match the two English sources.

calibration.note: الصفحة نفسها التي عوير عليها الخط الصيني (93) والألماني (92) والروسي (91). الدرجة 92 أُعطيت لنص الدورة الثالثة؛ وبعدها أعاد قرار إياد قيمة بند «مناسب لـ» إلى «خاندان · تصویر کشی · گرم دن» (P16) ولم يُعَد التحكيم. 22 حكماً في `calibration_rulings` و8 بنود في `open_items`. التقرير في `ur-translation/تقرير-المعايرة.md`، وأثر المراحل في `ur-translation/output/calibration-jabal-al-qarah/`.

open_items.title: How is the brand line itself written on /ur/ pages (site.brand: page titles, og:site_name, the copyright line, the Arabic line of the wordmark)?
open_items.provisional: Not ruled by the translation line: a brand name is not coined or transliterated here (N1). The key stays undefined and the Latin wordmark renders, as in the three earlier lines.
open_items.first_bites: every /ur/ page that is listed: its tab title, og:site_name and the footer; the owner's to decide

open_items.title: The approved tm.json pair for “the UNESCO World Heritage List”, «یونیسکو کی عالمی ورثے کی فہرست» (asfar faq[2].a, quoted by N16 (2); visa-guide intro.parts): five readers of five (b1-7, b2-6, b3-3, b4-6, b5-4) hear a double possessive and would say «یونیسکو کے عالمی ورثے کی فہرست» (N2’s own build, the form of the ui pairs «یونیسکو کے عالمی ورثے میں شمولیت», «یونیسکو کے عالمی ورثے کا حصہ»).
open_items.provisional: OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-17: the pair stays as it is on visa-guide (intro.parts unchanged in this amend) and is NOT changed page by page. الاحساء.source: ur.wikipedia.org — «الاحساء» 156 صفحة وعنوان «محافظہ الاحساء»، ومقابلها 3 صفحات فيها «الاحسا» بلا «الاحساء»؛ urdunews.com — ست مقالات: «الاحسا» بلا همزة ختامية 32 و«الاحساء» 4 داخل عنصر المقالة؛ وسوم الصحيفة: ‎/tags/الاحسا 95 مقالة و‎/tags/الاحساء 84 (قياس المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11)
الاحساء.note: P2 محسوم بقرار المالك (2026-10-12): «الاحساء» صيغة رأس الاسم في الموقع كله. «الاحسا» (صيغة اردو نیوز منذ منتصف 2019) تُسجَّل صيغةَ بحث ولا تُكتب في المتن. القراء العميان الثلاثة قرؤوها بلا توقف. P1 محسوم: الأداة مُبقاة. P11 محسوم: ألف مجرّدة لا «أ». P8 محسوم: الوصل بالواحة بالإضافة الأوردية «الاحساء کے نخلستان»، ولا كسرة على الاسم. P20 محسوم: في سطر المنطقة يتصدّر الاسم مجرّداً ثم «،»: «الاحساء، ہفوف کے مشرق میں». لم يُجَب بعدُ: كيف يُكتب سطر العلامة نفسه في /ur/ — يُحال إلى دفعة ui.ur. الجنس مذکر: «الاحساء … کیوں بنا». ‖ ROUND 3, b6: VARIANT FOR SEARCH, never written (ruling N92-governorate-with-or-without-a-gloss): «محافظہ الاحساء», the reference site's title for the governorate under which Salwa falls; the word was taken out of salwa-beach's body in round 1 because a reader read it as another word.

جبل القارہ.source: ur.wikipedia.org — عنوان المقالة «جبل القارہ (سعودی عرب)» = تسمية Wikidata Q12204761 الأوردية (تحقُّق حيّ، المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11: البحث الحرفي «جبل القارہ» = صفحة واحدة هي المقالة نفسها)
جبل القارہ.note: P1 محسوم: يُكتب الاسم كما في العربية بأداته. «جبل قارہ» (اردو نیوز، node/880305، 2024) و«القارۃ پہاڑ» (node/615586، 2021) صيغتان صحفيتان تُسجَّلان للبحث لا للمتن. P17 محسوم: التاء المربوطة «ہ» U+06C1. P3a محسوم: لا گلوس بين قوسين — «جبل» كلمة أوردية (ریختہ: جبل، اسم مذکر: پہاڑ، کوہ)، والقارئ الأعمى عدّ القوس شرحاً للكلمة الوحيدة التي يعرفها؛ فيكفي أن يرد اسم الجنس الأوردي «پہاڑ» منفرداً مرة في متن الصفحة بعيداً عن الاسم. ولا يُجمع الجنسان («جبل القارہ پہاڑ» ممنوع). لا كسرة إضافة على الاسم (P8). الجنس مذکر: «جبل القارہ … سر اٹھائے کھڑا ہے».

ہفوف.source: ur.wikipedia.org — عنوان المقالة «ہفوف» = تسمية Wikidata Q27136 الأوردية؛ «ہفوف» 104 نتيجة مقابل «الہفوف» 4 (قياس 2026-10-11)
ہفوف.note: P1 محسوم: اسمٌ له صيغة أوردية مستقرّة بلا أداة (نظير ریاض · دمام · قطیف · ظہران)، و«الہفوف» ممنوعة في المتن. في سطر المنطقة (P20): «الاحساء، ہفوف کے مشرق میں». القارئان الثاني والثالث وجداه غير معرَّف (لا شيء يقول إنه مدينة ولا كم يبعد) — وذلك سكوت المصدر (SD10) لا عيب في الرسم. الجنس مذکر: «ہفوف … ایک شہر ہے».

ارض الحضارات.source: ur.wikipedia.org — شاهد واحد داخل مقالة «جبل القارہ (سعودی عرب)»: «"ارض الحضارات" منصوبے کے تحت تیار کیا گیا ہے» (البحث الحرفي = 1، تحقُّق حيّ، المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11؛ المقالة مترجمة آلياً فهي شاهد للرسم لا للأسلوب). لا ورود في صفحات اردو نیوز المقروءة. والرسم مبنيّ من الرسم العربي الرسمي في ملف المعلم ‖ STAGE 4: not re-counted.
ارض الحضارات.note: P15 محسوم بقرار المالك (2026-10-12): قرية تراثية كما في المصدر الإنجليزي. الصيغة النهائية: الاسم بين “ ” أولاً ثم «نامی» ثم اسم الجنس «ثقافتی گاؤں» — «“ارض الحضارات” نامی ثقافتی گاؤں» — عند أول ذكر في كل حقل يُقرأ مستقلاً (خانة بطاقة، جواب سؤال، المتن)، وهي صيغة القارئ الأعمى الثالث بنصّها. P3b محسوم: گلوس المعنى «تہذیبوں کی سرزمین» مرة واحدة في الصفحة عند أول ورود بترتيب العرض، بين قوسين بعد علامة الإغلاق مباشرةً وقبل «نامی»، ولا يُكرَّر في جواب السؤال. جُرّب إسقاطه في الجولة الثانية فقال القارئ الثالث إن الاسم لا يحمل له معنى، فأُعيد. الاسم بين “ ” في كل ورود. مواءمة مصدر مرفوعة للمالك (SD6): الحقلان العربيان ما زالا يحملان الاسم وحده، ومتن العربية يسمّيه مشروعاً، ولا مصدر يقول أين القرية من الجبل ولا هل تُدفع الرسوم عند المدخل. P11: ألف مجرّدة. الجنس مذکر بحكم «گاؤں». ‖ STAGE 4: b9: the attraction's own page. Title «“ارض الحضارات”» (the key inside its marks, P3b (1); raised as N137); the gloss once, at the opening of the body, «“ارض الحضارات” (تہذیبوں کی سرزمین) نامی ثقافتی گاؤں اور نمائش» (P3b, P15; raised as N136); the four questions carry the quoted key, bare. ‖ STAGE 7 (round 1): b9: Ruled N137 A (title «“ارض الحضارات”», no gloss in the title) and N136 A (the body opens with the name, the gloss once there). Reader item 24 (moderate) found the quoted title a slogan: rejected under P3b, charged. Verified.

ثقافتی گاؤں.source: صيغة القارئ الأعمى الثالث بنصّها («ٹکٹ “ارض الحضارات” نامی ثقافتی گاؤں سے ملتے ہیں»، stages/06c-blind-reader-round3.md)؛ ur.wikipedia.org — «ثقافتی گاؤں» صفحتان كلتاهما لمَعلمٍ من هذا النوع («کٹارا ثقافتی گاؤں»، «کمبوڈیا ثقافتی گاؤں»)، و«نامی گاؤں» 222 صفحة؛ rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-gaanv — «گاؤں — اسم، مذکر» (تحقُّق الحاكم، 2026-10-12: s7-r2-last-out.txt · s7-r3-lookup-out.txt)
ثقافتی گاؤں.note: مدخل الجولة الثالثة (P15)، حلّ محلّ «ثقافتی ورثے کا گاؤں» المسحوب: القارئ الوحيد الذي قرأ ذاك سمعه ترجمةً وأخطأ تقطيع الجملة أولَ مرة. يرد بعد الاسم المقتبَس و«نامی»: «“…” نامی ثقافتی گاؤں». pending لسبب واحد: هو اقتراح قارئ لا نصٌّ قرأه قارئ أعمى في موضعه. الكلفة المعلومة: «ثقافتی» صفةٌ تؤدّي «تراثية» بأقرب معانيها، و«ورثہ» لم تعد ملفوظة. المردود: «ہیریٹیج ولیج» (صيغة اردو نیوز لأسماء المؤسسات، دخيل بلا مدخل معجمي — P16)، «ورثہ گاؤں» (تعليق صورة واحد في ur.wikipedia)، «تاریخی گاؤں / قریہ» (تدّعي قِدماً لا يحمله مصدر)، «تراثی» (ليست أوردية). الجنس مذکر («پرانا گاؤں» 14 مقابل «پرانی گاؤں» 1 في ur.wikipedia).

سعودی ریال.source: ur.wikipedia.org — عنوان المقالة «سعودی ریال» = تسمية Wikidata Q199857 الأوردية (قياس 2026-10-11)
سعودی ریال.note: P7 محسوم: «50 سعودی ریال» عند أول ذكر في كل حقل يُقرأ مستقلاً (خانة بطاقة، جواب سؤال، المتن)، ثم «50 ریال» لما يليه داخل الحقل نفسه. لا رمز لاتيني «SAR» في نص أوردي إطلاقاً — القارئ الأعمى قرأه رمزاً لا ثمناً وعدّ القوس «(SAR)» بقيةً من نسخة إنجليزية. العدد يسبق العملة، و«ریال» لا تتغيّر بعد العدد.

نخلستان.source: rekhtadictionary.com — «نخلستان: فارسی، عربی - اسم، مذکر»؛ ur.wikipedia.org — «نخلستان» 461 نتيجة مقابل «واحہ» 9؛ udb.gov.pk — لا مدخل لـ«واحہ» (قياس 2026-10-11)
نخلستان.note: المقابل الأوردي لاسم الجنس «واحة/oasis». الجمع المباشر كالمفرد والمجرور «نخلستانوں». «واحہ» ليست كلمة أوردية (فخ التعريب). وصل اسم الوجهة بها بالإضافة الأوردية (P8): «الاحساء کے نخلستان». وعبارة «دنیا کا سب سے بڑا نخلستان» لا تحمل «کھجور» ولا «قدرتی» في جملتها (قاعدة الموقع C15).

غار.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-gaar-1 — صفحة المدخل: «غار — اسم، مذکر» (تحقُّق المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11)؛ udb.gov.pk/result_details.php?word=162657 — المدخل لا يطبع وسم الجنس وشواهده بالصيغتين («بڑے غار میں» 1635 · «گہری غاریں ہیں» 1987)؛ ur.wikipedia.org — «غار» 1877 و«غاریں» 75
غار.note: P12 محسوم: مذکر — جمعه المباشر «غار» والمجرور «غاروں»، و«غاریں» لا تُكتب في الموقع. السند: ریختہ يطبع «اسم، مذکر»؛ والقارئ الأعمى لم يتوقف عند المذكّر، وقال حين سُئل إنه ما يقوله ويكتبه وإن «غاریں» تبدو له عاميةً في نص مكتوب. الاستعمال الصحفي منقسم (اردو نیوز تكتب الصيغتين وتخلطهما في المقالة الواحدة)، فالممنوع هو الخلط. حيث يحتمل اللفظ المفرد والجمع يُظهَر العدد بالفعل («غار ہیں») لا بكمّية مضافة.

پہاڑ.source: rekhtadictionary.com — صفحة المدخل «پہاڑ: اسم، مذکر» (تحقُّق المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11)؛ rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-jabal — «جَبَل: اسم، مذکر — پہاڑ، کوہ، پربت» (تحقُّق الحاكم، 2026-10-12، s7-rk-out.txt)
پہاڑ.note: اسم الجنس الأوردي لـ«جبل». P3a: في صفحة معلمٍ عنوانه «جبل …» يرد «پہاڑ» منفرداً مرة على الأقل في المتن بدل الگلوس بين قوسين، ولا يلاصق الاسم («جبل القارہ پہاڑ» ممنوع). «کوہ» لا تُستعمل (صفر في صفحات اردو نیوز الإحدى عشرة، و«جبل احد» 305 مقابل «کوہ احد» 8 في ur.wikipedia).

گوگل میپس.source: ur.wikipedia.org — عنوان المقالة «گوگل میپس» (pageid 986508) = تسمية Wikidata Q12013 الأوردية؛ مطلع المقالة «گوگل میپس ایک ویب میپنگ پلیٹ فارم ... ہے۔ یہ ... روٹ پلاننگ پیش کرتا ہے» (تحقُّق حيّ، المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11)
گوگل میپس.note: P16 محسوم: العلامة بالحرف الأوردي كما هي تسمية Wikidata وعنوان ur.wikipedia. ترد في سلسلة الواجهة det.openMaps؛ صيغة هذه المعايرة «گوگل میپس پر دیکھیں ↗» قرأها القارئ الأعمى الثاني بلا ملاحظة، وتُراجَع في دفعة ui.ur. الجنس مذکر بمطابقة الفعل في مطلع المقالة («پیش کرتا ہے»).

فیس.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-fees — صفحة المدخل: «فِیس — اسم، مؤنث» (تحقُّق المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11)
فیس.note: P16 محسوم: دخيل مقبول بقرار معجمي صريح — لا مقابل شائعاً له («رسوم» في الأوردو = العادات، فخّ تعريب). مؤنث: «داخلے کی فیس کتنی ہے». الجمع لا يُستعمل في الموقع حتى يُتحقَّق منه معجمياً.

ٹکٹ.source: udb.gov.pk/result.php?search=ٹکٹ — المدخل «ٹِکَٹ»، المعنى 4: «کسی سیر تماشے نمائش وغیرہ کو دیکھنے کا اجازت نامہ جو قیمت ادا کرنے پر ملتا ہے»، وشاهد «اپنا ٹکٹ اوپر بھیجا»؛ rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-ticket-ghar — تعريف «ٹکٹ گھر»: «وہ جگہ جہاں سے ... ٹکٹ ملتے ہوں» (تحقُّق المرحلة 4، 2026-10-11)
ٹکٹ.note: P16 محسوم: دخيل مقبول بقرار معجمي صريح. الجنس مذکر من مطابقة نصّ المعجمين («ٹکٹ ملتے ہوں»، «اپنا ٹکٹ») لا من وسم مطبوع: لم يُعثر على صفحة مدخل للكلمة في rekhtadictionary.com. الجمع «ٹکٹ»، و«ٹکٹیں» لا تُستعمل في الموقع.

سعودی عرب.source: ur.wikipedia.org — article title «سعودی عرب» (pageid 2153) = Urdu label and urwiki sitelink of Wikidata Q851; lead: «سعودی عرب (رسمی نام: …) مغربی ایشیا کا ایک ملک ہے» (API, read at stage 4, 2026-10-12)
سعودی عرب.note: Established Urdu exonym for the closed list of P1; the long form of the Arabic is not written. In b0-ui it stands in JSON-LD only (inline.home.country): no blind reader sees it, the proofreader and the judge are its only readers. Gender: the default of country names, NOT read on a dictionary page and not exercised (in the reference lead the agreement is with «ملک»). Shared with batch b1 under the same key. b1: once, in the al-uqair summary, before a postposition; the gender is not exercised there either.

خلیج.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-khaliij — entry page: «خَلِیج — اسم، مؤنث — (جغرافیہ) وہ قطعۂ آب جو تین طرف خشکی سے گھرا ہو …»; the bare form is the founding decision ruled in P5; ur.wikipedia «خلیج فارس» 658 pages and the title, «خلیج عرب» 30; press: urdunews.com/node/734286 «خلیج عرب کے ساحلوں پر» (all read at stage 4, 2026-10-12)
خلیج.note: P5 ruled in b0-ui round 1: the bare word, with no qualifier, on the whole site, also where a source writes 'Arabian Gulf' (the founding decision of all four lines); neither «خلیج فارس» nor «خلیج عرب» is written; the adjective is «خلیجی». Read in three strings by the blind reader without a remark on the word. Feminine on the dictionary entry page; in b0-ui the word is never the subject, so the gender is not exercised («خلیج کے کنارے کی بندرگاہ», «خلیج کی نیلاہٹ»). Batch b1 proposes the same key. b1 (rounds 1 to 3): six places on one page (al-uqair), bare, three of them where both sources write 'Arabian Gulf'; none of the three blind readers asked which gulf. The adjective twice on qasr-ibrahim («خلیجی خطے کے روایتی انداز میں», «خلیجی خطے میں درآمد»); the third reader noticed the two in a row. Never the subject of a verb in b1, so the gender is still not exercised.

بندرگاہ.source: usage, against the printed dictionary label. rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-bandargaah — entry page prints «بندرگاہ — اسم، مذکر، واحد»; the same dictionary prints feminine for the other words in «گاہ» read in this run («تَفْرِیح گاہ — … اسم، مؤنث», «قَیام گاہ — … مؤنث»); ur.wikipedia exact phrases: «کی بندرگاہ» 365 pages against «کا بندرگاہ» 11, «بڑی بندرگاہ» 41 against «بڑا بندرگاہ» 1, «بندرگاہ تھی» 43 against «بندرگاہ تھا» 11; press: urdunews.com/node/734286 «العقیر تاریخی بندرگاہ … اپنی عظمت منواتی رہی», «الاحسا کی تاریخی بندرگاہ»; udb.gov.pk — headword «بَنْدَر گاہ» found in the result list, its entry page could NOT be opened (HTTP 500 / connection closed) (stage 4, 2026-10-12)
بندرگاہ.note: Written feminine, as reference usage and the press have it («خلیج کے کنارے کی بندرگاہ», home.feat.lead and list.lead). PENDING because the one dictionary label that could be read says masculine and the Urdu Lughat entry page, which would decide, could not be fetched in stage 4 or in either judge round: the next stage that can reach udb.gov.pk/result_details.php?word=2172 settles it. Neither blind reader of b0-ui remarked on the agreement. Batch b1 proposes the same key. b1: feminine in three leaves of al-uqair («پہلی سمندری بندرگاہ», «اس قدیم بندرگاہ پر», «پرانی بندرگاہ کی»); neither blind reader of b1 remarked on the agreement. Urdu Lughat was tried again in b1's rounds 1 and 2 (in round 2 the entry page answered HTTP 500): still pending. b1 round 3: unchanged; a third reader read the three places without a remark on the agreement; Urdu Lughat was not tried again.

مینو.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-menuu — entry page: «مینُو — اسم، مذکر — بالعموم ریستورانوں میں رکھی گئی فہرست جس میں کھانوں کے نام اور قیمتیں درج ہوتی ہیں» (re-read by the judge, 2026-10-12); udb.gov.pk result list — headword «مینُو» (stage 4); for the function: MediaWiki Urdu message vector-main-menu-label = «مرکزی مینو»; Chrome Urdu resources (generated_resources_ur.xtb) «مینو» 15 and «مینیو» 21 occurrences; Android (AOSP core/res/values-ur/strings.xml) «مینیو» 5 (fetched by the judge, 2026-10-12)
مینو.note: P16: a loan admitted in b0-ui round 1 on the three conditions of item P16-test — the function is called by the loan in Android, Chrome and MediaWiki; the blind reader stumbled on «فہرست» (observation 1); a headword in both dictionaries. Spelled as the dictionaries head it, not «مینیو». The dictionaries' sense is the restaurant's list; the interface sense rests on the three interfaces. Used in two accessible names (a11y.menu, a11y.mainNav: «مرکزی مینو»). Masculine on the entry page; not exercised. Read by the second blind reader of the batch, whose phone is set to Urdu, without remark. The third reader also read it without remark: passed by both readers who saw it.

لنک.source: udb.gov.pk result list — headword «لِنک — ۱. دو چیزوں کو جوڑنے یا وابستہ کرنے والا … ۲. رابطہ نیز تعلق، لگاؤ» (stage 4, 2026-10-12; the site could not be reached again in this run); ur.wikipedia — «لنک» redirects to the article «ہائپرلنک» (pageid 6847, Wikidata Q102014); Chrome Urdu resources: «لنک کاپی ہوگیا» (ui_strings_ur.xtb), «لنک کاپی کریں», «نیا لنک طلب کرنے کے لیے», 144 occurrences of «لنک» and none of «ربط» (generated_resources_ur.xtb); Android «اس کے ساتھ لنکس کھولیں» (fetched by the judge, 2026-10-12)
لنک.note: P16: a loan admitted in b0-ui round 1 on the three conditions of item P16-test — «ربط» for a hyperlink is the usage of MediaWiki alone (whose Urdu also writes «ویب گاہ»); the blind reader read «ربط» as connection or coherence and could not parse the message (observation 37, serious); a headword of Urdu Lughat. Masculine by the agreement of the interfaces («نیا لنک», «لنک کاپی ہو گیا»), no printed label read. The Rekhta headword spelled «لنک» is another word (a heap). Used in plan.copied. Read by the second blind reader of the batch in «لنک کاپی ہو گیا ✓» without remark; the first reader's serious observation did not recur. The third reader also read the message without remark: passed by both readers who saw it. ‖ ROUND 3, b6: a new place of use, a sentence of a page that names a link of the page itself (asfar, faq[1].a), quoted with the label of the link as the interface shows it (ruling N89-interface-labels-quoted-in-a-sentence).

کاپی.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-copy-1 — entry page: «کَوپی — اسم، مؤنث — رک : کاپی», compounds «کاپی رائِٹ», «کاپی نَوِیس»; the dictionary's result list for the word: «کاپی کَرنا — اصل مضمون کو دیکھ دیکھ کر دوسرے کاغذ پر لکھنا، نقل کرنا»; its page for the English headword 'copy' lists «کاپی کَرنا» beside «نَقْل کَرنا», and its entry «نَقْل» defines that word with «کاپی»; Chrome Urdu resources: «لنک کاپی ہوگیا», «کلپ بورڈ پر کاپی ہو گیا» («کاپی ہو گیا» 12 occurrences, «نقل ہو گیا» 0); Android «کاپی کریں» (all fetched by the judge, 2026-10-12)
کاپی.note: P16: a loan admitted in b0-ui round 1 on the three conditions of item P16-test — the phone and the browser call the function «کاپی» and never «نقل»; the blind reader read «نقل» as imitation or cheating (observation 37, serious); dictionary entries as cited. Used only in the conjunct verb «کاپی ہونا / کاپی کرنا», where the verb agrees with the thing copied («لنک کاپی ہو گیا»); the noun is feminine on the entry page and is not used as a noun. Recorded for a judge who reads the owner's rule more strictly: «نقل» is a common Urdu word for a copy, and the wording with one loan fewer is «لنک نقل ہو گیا ✓», which no interface uses and no reader has seen. Read by the second blind reader of the batch in «لنک کاپی ہو گیا ✓» without remark. The third reader also read the message without remark: passed by both readers who saw it.

براؤزر.source: ur.wikipedia.org — article «ویب براؤزر» (pageid 7859, Wikidata Q6368); the title «براؤزر» redirects to it; Android (AOSP values-ur): «براؤزر شروع کریں؟»; Chrome Urdu resources: «اپنے براؤزر میں … ٹائپ کریں», «Chrome براؤزر … دکھانے کی کوشش کر رہا ہے» (101 + 59 occurrences) (fetched by the judge, 2026-10-12). براؤزر.note: P16: a loan admitted in b0-ui on the three conditions of item P16-test — Urdu has no other word in use for the thing («متصفح» 14 pages on ur.wikipedia, «مرورگر» 0); the first blind reader could not act on the notice that avoided it; reference attestation as cited. The second and third readers read it without remark and each used it in his own wording. PENDING because the third condition is met by the reference title and the interfaces only: a dictionary headword is still to be found. Masculine by the agreement of the interface («براؤزر … کر رہا ہے»). Used in map.locate.err («براؤزر میں دیکھ لیں کہ …»).

فارم.source: udb.gov.pk result list — headword «فارَم — ۱. وہ قطعۂ اراضی جو کاشت کے لیے مخصوص کیا جائے اور ایک منتظمہ کے ما تحت ہو» (stage 4, 2026-10-12); rekhtadictionary.com/urdu-meaning-of-farm — «مزرعہ، کھیت، فارم», and the dictionary's result list: «فارم کھولنا — کاشت کے لیے انگریزی طریقہ پر رقبہ مخصوص کردینا» (re-read by the judge); press: urdunews.com/node/589211 «یہاں کا کوئی زرعی فارم ایسا نہیں جس میں لیموں نہ اگتے ہوں», node/903042 «ریجن کی سب سے بڑے فارم کی مالک», node/755251 «اپنے زرعی فارم کا آغاز»
فارم.note: P16: a loan admitted in b0-ui on the three conditions of item P16-test (item N5) — «کھیت» is a cultivated field, not a farm one visits; the first blind reader could not tell what the label offers; a headword of Urdu Lughat. The word for the category of farms that receive visitors. Standing alone in a label it is written with the press's qualifier, «زرعی فارم» («بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم», nav.leisure): the second and the third reader both read the bare word first as the form one fills in — the same letters spell that loan («فارم پُر کرنا») — and the third names «زرعی فارم» among the words he expects. The qualified form has been read by no blind reader in place. Masculine by the agreement of the press («بڑے فارم کی», «اپنے زرعی فارم کا»), no printed label read and not exercised; plural «فارم», never «فارمز». «کھیت» remains a field in running text; an orchard is «باغ»; «باغات» is refused for the group (the 'gardens' of the parks label). ‖ STAGE 7 (b10, round 2): the farm CATEGORY label (CATEGORY_LABELS.ur.farm, N5's 'category label of the farm group') is «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات» (N161 C): the group is named by «زرعی فارم»; «باغات» stands there only qualified, «کھجور کے باغات», rendering the source's 'palms' by N5's own palm-grove clause — it is not the group's word, which stays refused. Cost: the shared word with the parks label in the index filters. ‖ STAGE 7 (b10, round 3): the qualified form «زرعی فارم» HAS NOW BEEN READ IN PLACE, in the farm category label, by three b10 readers (on-05, on-r1, on-r2), none of whom read «فارم» as a form to fill in: the base clause 'The qualified form has been read by no blind reader in place' is superseded. ‖ JUDGE ROUND 2 (b13-ui): the example label is now «بازار، پارک اور زرعی فارم» (nav.leisure since b13-ui; before it «بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم»), and the farm CATEGORY label is «زرعی فارم» alone since #175 (N161 as amended); the clauses quoting the older values are superseded.

چوغہ.source: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-choga — entry page, as stage 4 logged it: «چوغَہ کے اردو معانی — اسم، مذکر — عبا کی قسم کا ڈھیلا ڈھالا لباس …» (opened again by the proof of the round-2 text: the headword «چوغَہ», noun, masculine, 'a type of over coat, cloak'); the same dictionary heads the other spelling too, rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-chuga: «چُغَہ — اسم، مذکر — چغا — عبا کی قسم کا ڈھیلا ڈھالا لباس جس کا اگلا حصہ کھلا رہتا ہے» (stage 4); udb.gov.pk result list — «چوغَہ رک : چوغا», «چُغَہ رک: چغا» (stage 4); ur.wikipedia exact words — «چوغا» 32 pages, «چوغہ» 12, «چغہ» 11 (stage 2's count, not taken again). The Arabic of the source: «البشوت» (cat.crafts.d), «بشوتٌ» (home.route.s2.d). No page was opened by the judge in round 3.
چوغہ.note: The Urdu generic for the long open robe worn over the clothes: the batch's word for the source's 'cloaks' (Arabic «البشوت»), following the English as the Russian and German lines do; the garment's Arabic name «بشت» is not imported. Spelled with the waw: direct plural «چوغے», oblique plural «چوغوں» (home.route.s2.d, cat.crafts.d), never «چغے» / «چغوں». Evidence for the spelling: both spellings are dictionary headwords, the reference site writes the forms with the waw four times as often (44 pages against 11), and the readers' record agrees — the first read «چغوں» / «چغے» with no remark on the spelling, the second stumbled on «چغوں» and is used to «چوغہ / چوغوں», the third read «چوغوں» / «چوغے» with no remark on the spelling. Masculine on the dictionary page and exercised («کڑھے ہوئے چوغے»). The singular is not used in the batch: the key is the headword whose entry page was read; «چوغا», which Urdu Lughat's list refers to and the reference site prefers, gives the same two plurals and is recorded for search. Shared with the souq and craft pages of later rounds.

قصر صاہود.source: built from the Arabic name as it stands; its generic is an Urdu dictionary word in the sense of the English title — rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-qasr-1, entry page «قَصْر — اسم، مذکر», third sense «ایوان، محل، بارگاہ» (re-read by the judge, 2026-10-12); the pattern is that of the reference titles for Saudi palaces: «قصر ابراہیم» (pageid 2444298), «قصر خزام» (pageid 1090950), «قصر المربع» (pageid 2425880) (stage 4); NO Urdu attestation of this name in any form: ur.wikipedia exact phrases «قصر صاہود» 0 pages and «قلعہ صاہود» 0 (counted by the judge, 2026-10-12), «صاہود محل» 0 (stage 4); Wikidata Q12233052 (en 'Sahood Fort') has no Urdu label and no urwiki sitelink
قصر صاہود.note: N14 ruled in b1 round 1 for both attraction batches and kept in round 2: «قصر X» is the one form for an Arabic «قصر», in title and body; no labelled bracket and no gloss (the page says «قلعہ» in its summary and at the opening of its body, never next to the name). Replaces the stage-1 key «صاہود محل», which is retired and kept for search only: two blind readers took «X محل» for a royal palace and faulted the split with «قصر ابراہیم». Read blind in rounds 2 and 3: both readers passed the title above «دفاعی قلعہ»; the second read «قصر صاہود المبرز» as one long name, so the body opens with the place («المبرز کے قلب میں قصر صاہود کھڑا ہے۔»), which the third read without a stumble; since round 3 what the building is has a sentence of its own after it (item N31). The third reader asks what or who «صاہود» is, which no source says. Pending for one reason: nothing in Urdu names the fort. Never doubled («قصر صاہود محل»). Masculine by «قصر» (dictionary page), exercised: «قصر صاہود کھڑا ہے», «یہ … تعمیر ہوا».

مدرسہ امیریہ.source: built from the Arabic name in the form Urdu gives noun-plus-adjective school names (both articles dropped); ur.wikipedia exact phrase «مدرسہ امیریہ» 1 page — the namesake in Tulkarm («مدرسہ فاضلیہ 1882ء میں طولکرم میں “مدرسہ امیریہ” کے نام سے لڑکوں کے ابتدائی مدرسے کے طور پر قائم ہوا»), «المدرسہ الامیریہ» 0; the pattern in the names of historic schools of the Hijaz: «مدرسہ صولتیہ» (article title, pageid 719182; 23 pages), «مدرسہ الفلاح» (8 pages); no Urdu page names the Al-Ahsa school; gender by the head noun: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-madrasa — entry page «مَدْرَسَہ — اسم، مذکر، واحد» (all read at stage 4, 2026-10-12)
مدرسہ امیریہ.note: Pending because no Urdu source names this school; the form is not in doubt (the Arabic name's own noun is the Urdu word, so transliteration and translation coincide, as in «مسجد جواثا»). Item N15: the NAME keeps «مدرسہ»; the common noun for the school is «اسکول». Open item P3c (case b): to three blind readers of b1 a «مدرسہ» is a religious seminary, which is not what the source's name says, so the name is glossed once, at its first mention in the body of its own page: «مدرسہ امیریہ (یعنی امیریہ اسکول)»; the third reader says the gloss 'earns its place'. The title, the summary and the labels carry no gloss. The gloss is the P3c form and is NOT entered in this entry's gloss field, which is read for the quoted names of ruling P3b. What «امیریہ» refers to is in neither source. The article on the adjective is agreement, not part of a place name, so it goes with the generic's, as in «مسجد نبوی». Masculine, exercised: «جس ٹیلے پر یہ بنا ہے».

المبرز.source: ur.wikipedia.org — article title «المبرز» (pageid 1113048) = Urdu label and urwiki sitelink of Wikidata Q794958; lead «المبرز سعودی عرب کے مشرقی صوبے میں الاحساء میں واقع ایک شہر ہے»; exact phrase on 10 pages; gender by «شہر»: rekhtadictionary.com/meaning-of-shahr — entry page «شَہْر — فارسی - اسم، مذکر» (all read at stage 4, 2026-10-12)
المبرز.note: P1: the article is kept, as the reference title has it. Masculine by «شہر»; not exercised («المبرز کے قلب میں»). The word 'city' is not written after it: the English does not have it.

بنو عبد القیس.source: ur.wikipedia.org — article title «بنو عبد القیس» (pageid 3098977), lead «بنو عبد القیس عدنانی عربوں کے قبیلہ ربیعہ کی ایک قدیم، نامور اور معزز شاخ ہے»; exact phrase on 8 pages against «بنی عبد القیس» 1; press variant, written joined: urdunews.com/node/615586 «یہاں قبیلہ بنو عبدالقیس کے لوگ رہا کرتے تھے» (all read at stage 4, 2026-10-12); b1 round 2, counted by the judge on 2026-10-12: ur.wikipedia exact phrase «قبیلہ بنو» on 273 pages («قبیلہ بنو تمیم» 20)
